outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured images of photoactivation time-lapse experiments without quantification, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively)
outputs.explanation: Panel B shows quantitative intensity curves with error bars (in the insets, presented as averaged data), implying replicated measurements, but neither the number of replicates (cells/experiments) nor the type of replicate is stated anywhere in the caption.
